look.style: Warm paper, flat shapes, one hand-drawn line weight

zh.problem: 两个东西，中间隔着一道缝。
zh.promise: 把这份示范换成你自己的镜头。

en.promise: Replace this study with your own shots.

shots.action: The sender strains toward a receiver across a dashed gap; the camera pushes in on it

narration.en: Two things, and a gap between them.

shots.purpose: Introduce an action that changes the situation
shots.action: The sender throws a message pill; the camera pans with it across the gap
The pill hits the receiver, which recoils; a reply line is drawn back by a pen
The camera pulls back as five neighbours draw their links to the receiver

shots.purpose: Resolve the motif into the identity
shots.action: The network folds into the receiver; a pen writes the name onto it and underlines it

narration.zh: 最后，写上你自己的名字。
narration.en: Then write your own name on it.
